Class WaitPlayersStateDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.ActionJSON.State.StateDTO
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.ActionJSON.State.WaitPlayersStateDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class WaitPlayersStateDTO extends StateDTO implements Serializable
Represents the state of the game lobby where players are waiting to join. This state can be handled by the StateVisitor interface, allowing for visitor-based processing in the application. This class is immutable and serializable.
